title: Confirmation
description: Full-viewport order confirmation screen composing the order-summary block: the thank-you a shopper sees once the order is placed — an "Order placed" badge, the heading, the order number, the estimated delivery, where the receipt went and a Continue shopping button — beside a read-only recap of the lines and the totals that were paid, with the loading, error and empty states. Presentational — data and callbacks in, no navigation state — and responsive to its container (@container): the masthead lines up at @sm, the heading grows and the footer lines up at @md, and the order summary moves beside the thank-you at @lg; the block keeps reading its own container.
